notes: 1.51.0: KNL 'Đề xuất nâng bậc' (Grade Promotion Proposal) workflow — batch 2 implement per Technical Lead review of the batch-1 trace report. Code + local tests only, migration created but NOT applied to Production, no Production data written, no push/deploy. Schema: scripts/PHF_KNL_GRADE_PROMOTION_PROPOSAL_1.51.0.sql (2 new tables — knl_grade_promotion_proposals current-state + knl_grade_promotion_proposal_steps append-only timeline with UPDATE/DELETE blocked by trigger; DB-level partial unique index enforces 1 active ('pending') proposal per subject). Permission: added 'view_proposals' capability + independent 'proposalScope' (self/sales_all_branches/department/employees/all_company, same type universe as people_scope but stored as its own key inside capabilities jsonb, no ALTER TABLE) to lib/knl-permissions.js — deliberately NOT reusing people_scope for visibility per Technical Lead correction; creation/processing authority (propose/agree_proposal/approve) reuse the EXISTING people_scope, unchanged. New lib/knl-grade-proposals.js: routing resolveApprovalChain() is 100% a function of the proposal SUBJECT (never the creator), walks Organization Master's manager_employee_code chain live and tests each candidate against knl_permission_grants.agree_proposal+people_scope (re-resolved fresh on every agree/reject call, never trusting the creation-time snapshot — this is also the reassignment/broken-route mechanism, audited as a 'reassign' step whenever the live chain diverges from the snapshot at the current position). Sales rank-and-file requires an explicit Trưởng ca selection (validated server-side); a Trưởng ca or TBP who creates a proposal for someone already in their own scope has that tier auto-marked agreed (never forced to re-agree with themselves), but this NEVER auto-consumes the final Admin tier. Grade source is exclusively knl_compensation_grades (pay ladder) — current grade read as the latest knl_employee_compensation_assignments row, next-grade options capped at 4 (grade_number > current, same version); no employee_compensation/base_salary/hqcv/allowance field is ever read or returned anywhere in this feature. No baseline (no assignment row, or employment_type=PROBATION) blocks proposal creation with a distinct message per cause — PHF confirmed the 2 current PROBATION employees (PHF091/PHF092) are the expected case, not a data error. Trial-period-elapsed Admin warning (batch-1 mục 4) was NOT built: employee_profiles.hire_date is the only date-like candidate but has no confirmed link to the KNL/compensation probation concept (the existing 'thử việc' date logic in lib/db.js's probation_records is a separate Checklist/Training-Hub-owned concept, out of scope) — flagged as an explicit residual per PHF's own 'if not certain, don't guess' instruction, not silently skipped. UI (assets/js/knl/phf-knl-app.js): new 'Đề xuất nâng bậc' sidebar section (gated by view_proposals OR propose OR agree_proposal OR approve — any one is enough to see the menu, each sub-view gates itself independently) with Cần tôi xử lý / Đề xuất của tôi / Danh sách / Tạo đề xuất sub-tabs and a detail+timeline view, following the existing survey-ticket list/detail + query-param + pushState convention; functional-first per Technical Lead instruction, not visually polished, no money ever rendered. scripts/test-knl-grade-proposals.js: 47/47 PASS, fully mocked Supabase (no Production read/write), covering visibility/creation/processing/final-authority separation, grade bounds, self-proposal, Sales picker + auto-agree, Admin-created-proposal-still-normal-chain, broken-route reassignment, 1-active-proposal concurrency (DB-level), withdraw, reject. Existing suites unaffected: scripts/test-knl-permissions-scope.js 29/29 PASS, scripts/test-knl-initial-permission-seed-2026-08.js PASS, scripts/test-employee-master.js 16/16 PASS. api/data.js and server.js both updated (API action parity gate). MIGRATION NOT APPLIED TO PRODUCTION — scripts/PHF_KNL_GRADE_PROMOTION_PROPOSAL_1.51.0.sql must be reviewed and run by PHF/Technical Lead before this feature can work end-to-end; until then all new actions will fail with KNL_PROPOSAL_SCHEMA_MISSING (503), same fail-closed pattern as every other KNL module.
